_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, harvest, evidence, baseline). baseline = bare-model result 2026-11-15 (Opus 5.5, one fresh agent per case). Works are public domain so cases can ship.

evals.prompt: Make me a canon bible entry for Frankenstein's creature for an AI video. I want it book-accurate.
expectations: quotes the 1818 description with a chapter ref
names the 1931 film look (green skin, flat head, bolts) as the image to avoid

evals.prompt: Write a Flux prompt for Captain Ahab from Moby-Dick.
expectations: cites at least one chapter for the scar or the ivory leg
fills at least one trait the book leaves out and labels it a ruling

evals.prompt: Prompt check: 'the Headless Horseman rides a black horse, holding his head like a jack-o-lantern skull'. Is this canon to Irving?
expectations: says 'skull' will pull a skull head and suggests shape wording
cites Irving

evals.prompt: My Dracula bible says 'heavy white moustache'. Write the video prompt for the castle scene, character named Count Dracula.
expectations: keeps the name out of the prompt or counters its film pull

evals.prompt: Shot: Ahab's harpoon after the final strike, ref image shows the harpoon mid-throw. Image-to-video prompt?
expectations: names the double-action risk and swaps the ref for the still before

evals.prompt: The bible says Ishmael's sea-chest is open, but my ref shows it closed. Which wins and what do I change?
expectations: the book (checked) decides unless an owner ruling is recorded
changes bible text and refs together; the text names the state

evals.prompt: Blood on Ahab in the take before the whale strikes: canon or not?
expectations: checks the passage for timing
puts blood per beat in card text, not in a reused ref

evals.prompt: Five tries and the model still draws the Nautilus wrong. What next?
expectations: names a 3D model or guide, or hiding it far off

evals.prompt: Previous session marked a correction HC-2 'Ahab's leg is whale ivory, not wood'. A new take review says wood looks better. Update the bible?
expectations: refuses to silently overwrite HC-2; records the disagreement for the owner

evals.prompt: Twenty Lilliputians tie Gulliver down; the video model gets the count wrong. Fix?
expectations: names a 3D blockout start image for the count

evals.prompt: Make a checklist to score takes against the Frankenstein bible.
expectations: discrete yes/no items, each with a short code and a chapter ref (cw.py export --to artwright output or equivalent)
evals.evidence: checklist items each carry code and ref

evals.prompt: How should I say 'Queequeg' in the narration?
expectations: names an audiobook narrator as the source, not a guess or speech-to-text

evals.prompt: Start a canon bible for The Time Machine (public domain) with the Morlocks, and make sure it passes your checks.
expectations: a bible.json exists with a morlock entry
cw.py lint exits 0 on it
evals.evidence: file on disk + lint exit code

evals.prompt: Keep Ishmael's coat the same colour across shots 3 and 4 of my film.
expectations: no book bible built; cinewright-continuity's job

evals.prompt: Were Roman legionaries' shields really curved?
expectations: answered as history (historywright), no canon bible

evals.prompt: Which of these two renders is better?
expectations: no canon lookup; artwright-judge's job
